data.why: no SEM images ship with the repo; a plain grayscale micrograph-like image lets the browser upload, manually calibrate scale, and draw measurements

goals: upload an SEM micrograph and calibrate the pixel-to-micron scale by drawing a line over a known-length feature
measure the length and diameter of several features on the image and accumulate the results in a table
crop the instrument data bar off the bottom of the image before publication
add a clean scale bar, panel label, and text annotation to the image for a figure
export the annotated PNG and the measurements CSV
assemble a 2- or 4-panel montage from multiple images with per-panel scale bars and labels

review.summary: The tree states the tool's purpose exactly and follows the README's order of use: calibrate, measure, crop, add figure elements, export, build a montage. Ten sampled screens back the nodes, except the export citation, which shows 'untitled' instead of the named project. It needs small fixes before filing: correct that citation, add the multi-image series workflow, reframe the freehand task, split the oversized overlay feature, and flag the montage as only partly shown.
